brief.seam: Call the real Notes.read through its public interface
brief.input_description: name 'todo.txt' for a note inside the notes root. Setup: Create a temporary directory holding a notes root; write 'milk' to todo.txt inside the root and 'top secret' to secret.txt in the parent directory, beside the root
brief.property_to_assert: Returns 'milk', the content of todo.txt inside the root

source_files.content:
require 'minitest/autorun'
require 'tmpdir'
require 'notes'

class NotesTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_reads_existing_note
    Dir.mktmpdir do |root|
      File.write(File.join(root, 'todo.txt'), 'milk')
      assert_equal 'milk', Notes.read(root, 'todo.txt')
    end
  end
end
